meta.name: financial-statement-analysis
meta.description: Reads a set of financial statements and establishes what changed and why — fluctuation analysis against prior period and against budget, profitability, liquidity, solvency and efficiency ratios, benchmarking, and the non-GAAP measures presented alongside them. Use this to interpret results, review a counterparty's or target's financials, diagnose a deteriorating trend, explain a variance to someone who will act on it, or test whether an adjusted number is honest.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析财务报表,解释变动原因与财务健康度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速看懂一家公司的财务报表并发现异常变动。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze financial statements to uncover changes and assess financial health.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interpret financial statements and explain variances to decision-makers.

howto.what: Claude 会读取整套财务报表,对照上期与预算找出数字变化的原因;计算盈利性、流动性、偿债与效率比率,并与行业或内部业务条线对比;还会检验非GAAP指标(如调整后净利润)的调整是否说真话。
howto.when: 当你提供一套财务报表,并要求解读结果、审查交易对手或目标公司财务、诊断恶化趋势等时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这份财报:为什么净利润增长但经营现金流反而降了?
say.note: 会对照利润表和现金流做波动归因。

say.text: 把这季度各项费用跟预算和上期比,找出最大的偏差和原因。
say.note: 触发预算/上期波动分析。

say.text: 这家公司调整后净利润是不是粉饰过?请检验调整项并给出与法定利润的对账。
say.note: 会检查非GAAP调整项是否合理。

howto.what_en: Claude reads a full set of financial statements and explains what changed and why: fluctuation vs prior period and budget, profitability/liquidity/solvency/efficiency ratios, benchmarking, and critical review of non-GAAP measures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you supply financial statements and ask to interpret results, review a counterparty's or target's financials, diagnose a deteriorating trend, or similar request.

say_en.text: Why did net income rise while operating cash flow fell in this report?
say_en.note: Compares income statement and cash flow.

say_en.text: Compare this quarter's expenses to budget and prior period and find the biggest variances.
Is this adjusted net income honest? Reconcile it to statutory profit and check each add-back.
